name: agent-orchestration
description: Run a fast mandatory-autopilot control plane that delivers one foreground GitHub issue through verification, merge, pull, and declared-target deployment.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver one issue without approval churn.
interface.longDescription: Runs a fast project-scoped mandatory-autopilot control plane. One trusted authority envelope covers routine implementation, commit, push, PR, merge, canonical pull, cleanup, and declared-target deployment. It uses extra sessions and independent review when risk or policy warrants them while preserving required checks, secrets, revision-bound evidence, rollback, and production boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Make this task the mandatory-autopilot control plane. Finish one foreground issue at a time without approval prompts.
Use proportionate isolation and review; keep required checks and evidence truthful.
Use $sdlc-loop to deliver one foreground issue through merge, pull, and declared-target deployment.
